verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. Each has a sensible banner structure, with the quote on the left and the jar circle on the right. In both, the jar sits high in a circle cropped top and bottom instead of being centred in it, and the bottom-left logo is crammed near the bottom edge, left of the text column's left edge (x≈45–50 vs ≈108). The difference is the logo: A's SOLSTICE wordmark and sun mark stay legible, while B shrinks them to a near-illegible size, which weakens the brand mark.
